name: vault-panel
description: A local web password manager: view usernames and passwords in a table, export to Excel. No cloud, zero runtime dependencies. 本机运行的账号密码管理网页:表格查看用户名和密码,可导出 Excel。
author: Arra

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run verify && npm run build && npm run check:pack
